parameters.name: Aspect ratio
parameters.desc: Sets the shape of the frame. Both numbers must be integers.
parameters.note: HD output caps the ratio at 4:1.

parameters.name: Stylize
parameters.desc: How much of Midjourney's own aesthetic gets applied over your literal prompt. Low stays faithful, high prettifies.

parameters.name: Chaos
parameters.desc: How much the images in one grid differ from each other. Raise it when you want range, not polish.

parameters.name: Weird
parameters.desc: Pushes toward unconventional, off-kilter results. Stacks oddly with high stylize.

parameters.name: Raw mode
parameters.desc: Turns down the automatic beautification. Closer to what you literally asked for.
parameters.example: studio photo of a letterpress tray --raw

parameters.name: Experimental
parameters.desc: Adds depth, dynamics and a tone-mapped richness. Subtle low, heavy-handed high.
parameters.note: V7 and V8 only. Above roughly 25 it starts overriding --s and personalization, so pull one down when combining.

parameters.name: Negative prompt
parameters.desc: Names what you don't want in the frame.
parameters.example: still life with fruit --no bananas, text

parameters.name: Tile
parameters.desc: Makes the result a seamless repeating tile. The one to reach for on pattern work.
parameters.note: Not usable with the Edit model.

parameters.name: Seed
parameters.desc: Fixes the starting noise so you can change one word and compare like for like.

parameters.name: Style reference
parameters.desc: Match the look and feel of another image. `random` returns a reusable numeric code.

parameters.name: Style weight
parameters.desc: How hard the style reference pulls.

parameters.name: Omni reference
parameters.desc: Carries a specific person, character or object into a new scene.
parameters.example: a duckling holding a wand --oref URL
parameters.note: V7. Midjourney's own parameter list marks it replaced by the Edit model in V8.x, though some third-party V8.1 guides still document it. Treat as V7-era.

parameters.name: Omni weight
parameters.desc: How hard the omni reference pulls.

parameters.name: Character reference
parameters.desc: The earlier way to keep a character consistent.

parameters.name: Character weight
parameters.desc: Low keeps the face only, high carries clothing and framing too.

parameters.name: Personalization
parameters.values: Bare flag for your default, or a profile / moodboard ID
parameters.desc: Applies the taste profile built from the image pairs you rated.
parameters.example: a cosy reading nook, rain on the window --p

parameters.name: Image weight
parameters.desc: How much an attached image prompt counts against your text.
parameters.note: Requires an image prompt. Niji 7 caps at 2.

parameters.name: Version
parameters.desc: Picks the model. Prompts written for one version rarely behave the same on another.
parameters.note: V8.2 became the default around 24 July 2026. Midjourney's older GitBook docs still say V7 is the default, so that page is stale.

parameters.name: Niji
parameters.desc: The anime and illustration model.
parameters.example: a girl and her cat on a train --niji 7

parameters.name: HD
parameters.desc: Renders at 2048px natively instead of upscaling.
parameters.note: Costs more GPU time and caps aspect ratio at 4:1. One API reseller's guide claims --hd does nothing in a prompt, but that describes their API, not the Midjourney app.

parameters.name: SD
parameters.desc: Renders at 1024px for less GPU time.

parameters.name: Draft
parameters.desc: Fires off a batch of small rough images cheaply. The right tool for finding a direction before committing.
parameters.note: Website only. Produces 24 images around 512px. Cannot be combined with an image prompt, --sref, --oref or HD.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.desc: Trades render time against detail.
parameters.note: Sources disagree. One current cheat sheet says V8.1 and V8.2 dropped --q entirely and that V7 takes 1, 2 or 4; an API guide says V8.1 takes 1 or 4; Midjourney's legacy docs list .25, .5 and 1 for the V6 era. Check against your own version before relying on it.

parameters.name: Stop
parameters.desc: Halts the render early for a softer, less resolved image.
parameters.note: V6 and earlier. Reported unavailable in V8.

parameters.name: Repeat
parameters.values: Up to 4, 10 or 40 depending on plan
parameters.desc: Runs the same prompt several times in one go.

parameters.name: Video
parameters.desc: Saves a progress video of the initial grid being built.

parameters.name: Fast mode
parameters.desc: Runs this one job at full speed against your fast hours.

parameters.name: Relax mode
parameters.desc: Runs this one job in the queue instead of burning fast hours.

parameters.name: Turbo mode
parameters.desc: Runs this one job on the fastest tier.

parameters.name: Stealth mode
parameters.desc: Keeps this job off your public profile. Pro and Mega plans.

parameters.name: Public mode
parameters.desc: Forces this job public even on a stealth-capable plan.
